answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the river of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A zephyr of per-task receipts records who did what, and the fable of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
